description: This file defines the TextElement class within the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\RichText namespace. It manages text content for rich text elements, allowing setting and retrieving text, but does not support font modifications.

classes.name: TextElement
classes.description: Represents a text element in a rich text object, encapsulating the text content and related methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the TextElement class with optional text.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content and returns the instance for method chaining.

methods.name: getFont
methods.description: Returns null as font manipulation is not supported in this class.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the text content and class name.
